gazetteer_names_needed.name: Royal Prussia
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Pomeranian voivodeship (without Słupsk and the Lauenburg-Bütow Land and without Kwidzyn), the Chełmno Land and the Elbląg district, about 21,250 km2; 'West Prussia' (alt name Royal Prussia) is the Pomeranian + Kuyavian-Pomeranian voivodeships and is wrong for it

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Chełmno Land
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Culm land north of the Vistula and west of the Drwęca: Toruń, Chełmno, Świecie, Grudziądz, Brodnica, Tuchola; the dossiers use a polygon intersected with the Kuyavian-Pomeranian voivodeship

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Netze District
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: 1772-1807 Prussian district along the Noteć: Wałcz, Kamień, Bydgoszcz, Inowrocław, Piła; about 12,000 km2 on the grid

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Brześć Kujawski Voivodeship
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: southern Kuyavia (Włocławek, Radziejów, Brześć Kujawski) plus Dobrzyń Land: the Kuyavian-Pomeranian voivodeship south of the Chełmno Land line

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Lauenburg and Bütow Land
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Lębork, Bytów, Łeba, about 3,000 km2; Royal Prussian 1637-1657 only

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Marienwerder district
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Kwidzyn, Susz, Prabuty: Teutonic Upper Prussia and Ducal Prussia until 1772/1773, then West Prussia

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Warmia
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: EXISTING region resolves to 12,645 km2 (takes in Elbląg, Ostróda, Pasłęk, Morąg, Bartoszyce); the Warmia article gives about 4,500 km2; should be cut to Braniewo-Frombork-Orneta-Lidzbark-Reszel-Barczewo-Olsztyn

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Kuyavia
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: EXISTING region is the whole Kuyavian-Pomeranian voivodeship (19,726 km2) with Toruń, Chełmno, Grudziądz and Bydgoszcz; historic Kuyavia is the Brześć Kujawski and Inowrocław land south of the Vistula and Noteć

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Włocławek
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Kuyavian town on the Vistula, 19.07 E 52.65 N

problems: All four dossiers validate with --resolve: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Files written to the mount and read back identical after 12 s; no temporary file was left on the mount. 17 Wikipedia pages opened this run (Royal Prussia, Truce of Altmark, Treaty of Stuhmsdorf, Polish-Swedish War 1626-1629, The Deluge, Prince-Bishopric of Warmia, Lidzbark Warmiński, Warmia, Netze District, Province of West Prussia, Kwidzyn, South Prussia, Gdańsk, New Silesia, Great Prussian Uprising, Pomeranian Voivodeship 1466-1772, Lauenburg and Bütow Land); none failed.

Fixes applied (11): royal-prussia shape and Swedish occupations; warmia shape, capitals, counterpart/uprising; south-prussia Kuyavia double drawing, the first-french-empire counterpart, the 1795-96 borders; west-prussia 1773-1792, the 1793-1806 overlap and the 1815-1918 shapes. Not fully closed: royal-prussia capital (page silent), warmia events 1466-1525 (page silent), west-prussia capital years (page silent).

Disagreement with the reviewer (royal-prussia): Lębork and Bytów are not simply outside. The Royal Prussia page lists the Lauenburg and Bütow Land; the Lauenburg and Bütow Land and Pomeranian Voivodeship pages put it in the Pomeranian voivodeship from 1637 (1641) to 1657 only. Out of the core shape, in for 1637-1656 (keyframes 1637 and 1657, gain 1637, loss 1657).

Disagreement/reading (warmia): the grid cannot draw 4,500 km2 exactly; 5,060 km2 (20 cells, ratio 1.12) with the six key towns inside. The 1260-1274 contest with old-prussians is my reading (the uprising page does not mention the bishopric); old-prussians ends its uprising in 1277, the page says 1274.

Disagreement (west-prussia): the Netze District page puts the Wałcz-Kamień incorporation in 1807, the Province page in 1815; drawn from 1807. The Netze District is a separate territory 1772-1774 and joins West Prussia in 1775, so West Prussia now starts with Royal Prussia + Marienwerder only (20,240 km2). Poland plus Danzig in 1919 come to 70% of the drawn province against 62% on the page.

Mirror events the neighbours' owners should add: kingdom-of-sweden occupation_start/_end for royal-prussia (1626-07 to 1629-09 and 1635-09; 1655-11 to 1658-12, 1659 and 1660-05) and for the prince-bishopric (1626-07 to 1629-09 and 1635-09); duchy-of-pomerania loss of the Lauenburg and Bütow Land 1637; brandenburg-prussia 1657 gain currently names the Commonwealth; teutonic-order vassal events for Warmia (1243-1464); old-prussians contest with Warmia 1260-1274; kingdom-of-prussia 1806-10 contest names first-french-empire (matches south-prussia now).

new-east-prussia (verdict fix, not in this repair): its 45 km Płock and 30 km Dobrzyń circles still cross the Vistula; south-prussia now clips the same land with a polygon along the Vistula (Dobrzyń Land only) and the circles overlap south-prussia's Włocławek area; clip them by the south-prussia 1795 and west-prussia 1793 shapes.
